ruleName: Out of bounds and provisional ball
group: Out of bounds and provisional ball
title: What happens to your provisional ball?
question: After you've played a provisional ball because your first shot might be out of bounds, what do you do if it's clear your first ball is definitely out?

choices.text: Your provisional ball becomes your ball in play and you get a one-stroke penalty.
You must pick up your provisional ball and drop another ball at the out of bounds spot.
You can keep playing your original ball with no penalty.

explanation: If your original ball is confirmed out of bounds, your provisional ball becomes your ball in play, and you must add a one-stroke penalty.
